hero.title: Cosmetic veneers
hero.lead: A veneer is a thin porcelain shell bonded to the front of a tooth. Veneers can change the shape, colour and length of teeth for a more even smile.

intro.heading: Things to know before choosing veneers
intro.html:
To fit a veneer, a thin layer of enamel is usually removed from the front of the tooth so the veneer sits naturally. This step is permanent, so veneers are a long-term commitment.

Your dentist will check the health of your teeth and gums, look at your bite, and talk about the look you want, including the colour and shape of the veneers.

explain.heading: What veneers can help with
explain.intro: Your dentist will check that veneers are the right option for your teeth and explain any alternatives.

process.heading: Two appointments
steps: Impressions are taken and your teeth are prepared, which may mean removing a small amount of enamel; sometimes none is needed. You leave with temporary veneers while your permanent ones are made.
Your permanent veneers are bonded in place, and your dentist makes any adjustments so they look and feel right, then shows you how to care for them.

weigh.heading: Benefits and things to consider
benefits: Can improve colour, shape and the appearance of gaps
consider: Veneers can chip and may need replacing in future
Grinding your teeth can shorten their life, and a night guard may be recommended

care.heading: Looking after your veneers
items: Brush and clean between your teeth as normal. Veneers need the same care as natural teeth.
Biting very hard things such as ice, pens or fingernails.
Regular check-ups let your dentist check the veneers and the teeth underneath.

faqs: It varies with your bite, habits and oral health. Your dentist can talk you through what to expect.
Your dentist will plan the shape and shade with you so they suit your face and the colour of your other teeth.
cost: The cost depends on what your mouth needs, so it can only be worked out after an examination.
